title: Global Hom of the canonical integral Roos limit
statement: For every normalized DVR tower T, there is a natural isomorphism of functors integralDualizingGlobalHom l E X ((integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower) and integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower ⋙ CoefTower.totalLimit (integralDualizingCoefficients l E).

proof.text: Use the resolution clause of the global-RHom derived-limit theorem on a complex representing T.tower to obtain a K-injective tower complex I with injective terms and QI isomorphic to T.tower.

The degreewise inverse-limit complex is the ordinary limit of I.asFunctor. The exact constant-tower functor is left adjoint to inverse limit, so this complex is K-injective. The derived unit of the canonical integralDualizingLimit is invertible on I; composing it with the resolution isomorphism identifies Q(lim I) with integralDualizingLimit(T.tower). This is implemented by evaluatedLimitCone, evaluatedLimitIso and evaluatedLimitKInjective.

Apply the fixed-target natural global-Hom complex model to lim I. Apply the ordinary-limit model of the resolved strict mapping tower to I. These assertions concern distinct sides of the argument and do not compare the two derived limits.

For each source P, the existing resolved-tower model makes limit.post for representative(P,-) invertible. These maps are natural in P: compose both sides with each limit projection, use limit.post_π and limMap_π, and then naturality of the Hom precomposition map at the original projection. Localize to obtain resolvedHomLimitIso, the actual bridge between the two complex models.

Compose the source model, the localized ordinary Hom/limit comparison, and the inverse target model, transporting along the resolution and canonical-limit isomorphisms. Full faithfulness of precomposition with Q.op descends this isomorphism from complexes to the entire opposite derived category. Restrict to constructible inputs, recovering the two originally defined functors.

lean.statement: theorem integralDualizing_mapping_tower_limit_canonical (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl) : Nonempty (integralDualizingGlobalHom l E X ((integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower) ≅ integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower ⋙ CoefTower.totalLimit (integralDualizingCoefficients l E))
